sql: WITH s AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker, date_trunc('hour', at)) market_ticker, date_trunc('hour', at) AS hr, program_row_id, best_yes_bid, best_no_bid, est_yes_meets_target AS my, est_no_meets_target AS mn FROM incentive_market_snapshots WHERE at >= '2026-09-17' AND book_valid ORDER BY market_ticker, date_trunc('hour', at), at DESC) SELECT date_trunc('week', s.hr)::date AS wk, count(*) FILTER (WHERE LEAST(s.best_yes_bid, s.best_no_bid) BETWEEN 11 AND 50 AND s.my AND s.mn) AS mid_hours, count(DISTINCT s.market_ticker) FILTER (WHERE LEAST(s.best_yes_bid, s.best_no_bid) BETWEEN 11 AND 50 AND s.my AND s.mn) AS mid_mkts, count(DISTINCT p.event_ticker) FILTER (WHERE LEAST(s.best_yes_bid, s.best_no_bid) BETWEEN 11 AND 50 AND s.my AND s.mn) AS mid_events, count(*) AS all_hours FROM s LEFT JOIN incentive_programs p ON p.id = s.program_row_id WHERE coalesce(p.incentive_type,'') ILIKE '%liquid%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
